title: Machine Learning Basics
abstract: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that focuses on training algorithms to learn from data. Neural networks are a key component of deep learning. The algorithm processes training data to build models that can make predictions.

title: Data Science Applications
abstract: Data science combines statistics, machine learning, and domain expertise. Scientists analyze datasets to extract insights. Python is a popular language for data analysis. Libraries like NumPy and Pandas are essential tools.

title: Natural Language Processing
abstract: Natural language processing enables computers to understand human language. Transformers and BERT models have revolutionized NLP. Applications include sentiment analysis, machine translation, and question answering. The field combines linguistics and machine learning.

title: Graph Theory Concepts
abstract: Graphs consist of nodes and edges that represent relationships. Graph databases like Neo4j store complex relationship data efficiently. Knowledge graphs organize information about entities. Graph algorithms solve optimization problems in networks.
